usage.summary:
Implemented the hand-over core, Gobra contracts, explorer and model adjustments. Ratified definitions remain unchanged.

Gate passed on run 2 of 4: 7,296 states explored, all witnesses reached, all properties verified, all known bugs caught, conformance and larger-bound checks passed, Gobra proofs verified, and build green.

pins.name: Spec
pins.says: The hand-over starts in its initial state and proceeds through the modeled core and caller steps.

pins.name: PublicationIsVerified
pins.says: The core requests publication only after the hidden copy was found identical to the spool file, and every publication carries that evidence.

pins.name: SpoolRemovalIsSafe
pins.says: The original is requested for removal or removed only after verified delivery and expiry of its retention time.

pins.name: NoCopyAfterPublication
pins.says: Once the recording has been published, the core never requests another copy, including after an interruption before recording success.

pins.name: OneCopyAtATime
pins.says: At most one copy of the recording is being executed at a time.

pins.name: ReplayKeepsIdentity
pins.says: A repeated request retains the saved operation, names and identity, including while its execution or result is outstanding.

pins.name: OnlyOwnedNames
pins.says: Every request to change or remove a file targets only the appropriate hidden name, recording name or original spool file belonging to this hand-over.

pins.name: CopiesAreHidden
pins.says: Every copy request uses the hand-over’s hidden name with a leading dot.

pins.name: NewCopiesStartCleanly
pins.says: A new copy is requested only after any previous hidden copy has been removed.

pins.name: DifferenceLimitStopsCopying
pins.says: Reaching the configured limit of differing copies permits only their cleanup before the attempt finishes.

pins.name: AtMostOnePublication
pins.says: The recording is published at most once across all interruptions and retries.

pins.name: ForeignFileIsPreserved
pins.says: A file already occupying the final name is never replaced or removed by this hand-over.

pins.name: SuccessHasEvidence
pins.says: A successful hand-over has an identical file at its final name and recorded verification evidence.

pins.name: FailureKeepsSpool
pins.says: A failed hand-over records its reason and retains the original spool file.

pins.name: DifferentCopyIsNotPublished
pins.says: A differing hidden copy never carries permission to be published.

pins.name: DifferenceLimitCleansUp
pins.says: An attempt that fails for exhausting its differing-copy limit has removed the last differing copy.

pins.name: ExistingMatchAvoidsCopy
pins.says: An identical file present at the final name when the hand-over begins is accepted without making a copy.

pins.name: CleanupCannotUndoDelivery
pins.says: Waiting for retention, removing the original, or failing and retrying that removal leaves the hand-over successful.

pins.name: TypeOK
pins.says: Every state component stays within its declared type and exploration bounds.

pins.name: DeliveredByCopy
pins.says: A new copy can be verified and published while the original remains in the spool.

pins.name: AcceptedExisting
pins.says: An identical existing file can be accepted without copying.

pins.name: ConflictingName
pins.says: A differing existing file can cause a name-conflict failure while remaining unchanged.

pins.name: FolderGone
pins.says: A missing folder can end the hand-over with that failure reason.

pins.name: FolderFull
pins.says: A full folder can end the hand-over with that failure reason.

pins.name: DifferencesExhausted
pins.says: Repeated differing copies can reach the limit, be cleaned up and produce the specified failure.

pins.name: ReplacedDifferentCopy
pins.says: A differing copy can be removed and replaced by a copy that is successfully handed over.

pins.name: RetriedDelivery
pins.says: A failed hand-over can be retried successfully.

pins.name: RecoveredPublication
pins.says: An interruption after publication but before recording success can be recovered by repeating the original request.

pins.name: RetainingOriginal
pins.says: A successful hand-over can retain its original while the retention time has not elapsed.

pins.name: OriginalRemoved
pins.says: The original can be removed after successful hand-over and expiry of retention.

pins.name: CleanupFailed
pins.says: Removal of the original can fail while the hand-over stays successful and the original remains.

pins.name: CleanupRetried
pins.says: A failed removal of the original can be retried successfully.

pins.name: IssueProgress
pins.says: If issuing the next saved request is possible repeatedly, the core eventually issues it.

pins.name: ResendProgress
pins.says: If repeating an interrupted request is possible repeatedly, the core eventually repeats it.

pins.name: ConsumeProgress
pins.says: If recording a completed caller result is possible repeatedly, the core eventually records it.

pins.name: RetentionProgress
pins.says: If starting original removal after retention is possible repeatedly, the core eventually starts it.

pins.name: StartedAttemptFinishes
pins.says: If execution keeps resuming and the caller eventually answers outstanding requests, each started attempt eventually reports success or failure.

pins.name: PublishUnchecked
pins.says: The core requests publication before comparing the copy.

pins.name: RemoveSpoolEarly
pins.says: The core requests removal of the original before delivery.

pins.name: RestartAfterUnrecordedPublication
pins.says: After an interrupted publication, recovery requests a fresh copy instead of repeating the saved publication request.

pins.name: CopyWhileBusy
pins.says: A second copy is started while the first copy is still in progress.

pins.name: RemoveUnrelatedFile
pins.says: Discarding a differing copy mistakenly requests removal of an unrelated file.

usage.summary:
I found two problems in the explorer’s evidence.

- [.invariant/invariant.json:5](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-review-2499510997/.invariant/invariant.json:5): The manifest omits `MaxDifferences` from its parameters, although `Init()` passes it to `New` as `differenceLimit` and `Consume` uses it to stop copying. This is a configurable limit the code must enforce, so it cannot be classified solely as an environment bound.

- [handover/explore.go:62](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-review-2499510997/handover/explore.go:62): `coreResult` reads `next.Record` only when `ok` is true. On refusal, it reports the input state instead of the returned record. That assumes refusals preserve state and would conceal a violation of that requirement; the returned record should be observed regardless of `ok`.

review.text:
I found two problems in the explorer’s evidence.

- [.invariant/invariant.json:5](invariant.json:5): The manifest omits `MaxDifferences` from its parameters, although `Init()` passes it to `New` as `differenceLimit` and `Consume` uses it to stop copying. This is a configurable limit the code must enforce, so it cannot be classified solely as an environment bound.

- [handover/explore.go:62](explore.go:62): `coreResult` reads `next.Record` only when `ok` is true. On refusal, it reports the input state instead of the returned record. That assumes refusals preserve state and would conceal a violation of that requirement; the returned record should be observed regardless of `ok`.
